full_judgment: 4. Defendants contested the suit by filing a written statement contending, inter alia, that the suit land belonged to Zaminder and CS Khatian was prepared in the name of Zaminder and by operation of law the same vested in the Government after the State Acquisition and Tenancy Act, 1950 (the Act) came into being. Record of right was correctly prepared in 1962 in the name of the Government. Further case of the defendants was that the plaintiffs had/have no right, title and interest in the suit land. In order to grab the suit land of the Government plaintiffs created some false documents and instituted the present suit.
